chunks:
[Coming to Medina]
When you enter Medina, perform ghusl (ritual bath) before entering it or when you enter it. Then go to the grave of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله and enter the mosque through the Gate of Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام. When you enter, send salutations upon the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, then stand at the foremost column on the side of the grave, near the corner of the grave, while facing the qiblah, with your left shoulder toward the side of the grave and your right shoulder toward the minbar, for that is the place of the head of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله. Then say:

"I bear witness that there is no god but Allah alone, having no partner, and I bear witness that Muḥammad is His servant and His Messenger, and I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah, and I bear witness that you are Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh. And I bear witness that you conveyed the messages of your Lord, sincerely advised your Ummah, strove in the way of Allah, and worshipped Allah with sincerity until certainty came to you. And you called to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good exhortation, and fulfilled the duty of truth that was upon you, and that you were compassionate toward the believers and stern against the disbelievers, so Allah caused you thereby to reach the noblest station of the honored. Praise belongs to Allah who rescued us through you from shirk and misguidance. O Allah, place Your blessings, and the blessings of Your near angels, Your righteous servants, Your sent prophets, the inhabitants of the heavens and the earths, and whoever glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds, from the first and the last, upon Muḥammad, Your servant, Your Messenger, Your Prophet, Your trustee, Your confidant, Your beloved, Your chosen one, Your special one, Your elite from among Your creation, and Your chosen from among Your creatures. O Allah, grant him the rank and the means from Paradise, and raise him to a praised station by which the first and the last will envy him. O Allah, indeed You have said, and Your word is the truth:"

"And had they, when they wronged themselves, come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah, and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would surely have found Allah Accepting of repentance, Merciful."

And I have come to Your Prophet seeking forgiveness, repenting from my sins. O Messenger of Allah, I turn by means of you toward Allah, my Lord and your Lord, that He may forgive my sins."
And if you have a need, then place the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله behind your shoulders, face the qiblah, raise your hands, and ask for your need, for it is fitting that it be fulfilled for you, if Allah the Exalted wills.

Then say, while resting your back against the green, narrow stone on the side near the grave, leaning against it and facing the qiblah: "O Allah, to You I have entrusted my affair, and against the grave of Muḥammad, Your servant and Messenger, upon whom be Your blessings and upon his family, I have set my back, and I have faced the qiblah which You approved for Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله. O Allah, I have come to morning not possessing for myself the good that I hope for it, nor can I repel from it the evil that I fear for it, and affairs have come to be in Your hand. So there is no poor one poorer than me; indeed I am, for whatever good You send down to me, in need. O Allah, return me from You with good, for there is none to repel Your bounty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from changing my name, altering my body, or removing Your blessing from me. O Allah, adorn me with taqwa, beautify me with blessing, envelop me in well-being, and grant me Your gratitude."

key_terms.اغْتَسِلْ: perform ghusl (ritual bath) before or upon entry
key_terms.الشِّرْكِ: associating partners with Allah, from which people were rescued through the Prophet’s mission
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of prayer to be faced during the visitation and supplication
key_terms.الْمَدِينَةَ: Medina, the sacred city being visited
key_terms.رِسَالَاتِ: the divine messages conveyed by the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and etiquette for visiting the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم in Medina?
ai.summary: This passage teaches the etiquette of visiting al-Madīnah and the grave of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, combining ritual preparation, salutations, testimony to his mission, and supplication. It emphasizes seeking forgiveness through coming to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, facing the qiblah for du'a, and asking Allah for taqwa, blessing, well-being, and gratitude.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
VISITING MEDINA
When you enter Medina, perform ghusl (ritual purification) before entering or upon entering. Then proceed to the grave of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). Enter the mosque through the Gate of Jibreel (as). Upon entering, offer salutations to the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family). Stand by the pillar closest to the grave, near the corner, facing the qibla, with your left shoulder towards the grave and your right shoulder facing the minbar (pulpit). This is the position of the Prophet's head. Then say:

"I bear witness that there is no god but Allah (swt), and He has no partner. I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. I bear witness that you are the Messenger of Allah (swt). I bear witness that you are Muhammad, the son of Abdullah. I bear witness that you have conveyed the messages of your Lord (azj), advised your community, struggled in the way of Allah (swt), and worshipped Allah (swt) sincerely until certainty (death) came to you. You called towards the path of your Lord (azj) with wisdom and good exhortation. You fulfilled your obligations, showed compassion to the believers, and were stern against the disbelievers. Allah (swt) raised you to the highest station among the honored.
Praise be to Allah (swt), who saved us through you from polytheism and misguidance. O Allah (swt), send Your blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant, Messenger, Prophet, trustee, confidant, beloved, chosen one, and the best of Your creation. Bestow upon him and elevate his station in Paradise, granting him the praised position that the first and the last will envy.
O Allah (swt), indeed, You have said, and Your word is the truth:

"And had they, when they wronged themselves, come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah (swt), and the Messenger had asked forgiveness for them, they would have found Allah (swt) Accepting of Repentance and Merciful."

O Messenger of Allah (swt), I have come to your presence seeking forgiveness, repenting from my sins. O Messenger of Allah (swt), I seek your intercession before Allah (swt), your Lord (azj) and mine, that He may forgive my sins.
If you have a personal need or prayer, turn your back to the Prophet’s grave, face the qibla, raise your hands, and ask for your need. It is very likely that your request will be granted, God willing.

Then say, while resting your back against the green and slender wall next to the grave, facing the qibla:
"O Allah (swt), I have entrusted my affairs to You and turned my back towards the grave of Muhammad, Your servant and Messenger, upon whom be Your blessings and his family. I am facing the qibla that You approved for Muhammad, peace be upon him and his family.
O Allah (swt), I acknowledge that I have no control over the good I hope for myself, nor the ability to avert the harm I fear upon myself. All affairs rest in Your hands. No one is poorer than me. Truly, I am in need of whatever good You send to me.
O Allah (swt), let me return from Your presence with goodness, for there is no one to turn back Your bounty. O Allah (swt), I seek refuge in You from having my name replaced, my body altered, or Your blessings removed from me.
O Allah (swt), adorn me with piety, beautify me with blessings, envelop me in well-being, and grant me the ability to thank You."
